models.name: Model D3
models.what_it_computes: A detailed 3D implicit finite element model of the optic–haptic assembly in contact with a deforming capsular bag that computes haptic stresses, capsule–haptic contact pressures, and optic tilt/decentration under prescribed capsular contraction.

models.name: Model RB
models.what_it_computes: A reduced-order implicit finite element ring–beam model that represents the capsule as a contracting ring and the haptics as curved beams connected to a rigid optic, computing global stiffness, peak beam stress, and optic kinematics under contraction loads.

mechanisms.name: Uniform equatorial contracture
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Circumferential shrinkage of the equator elevates haptic loads, risking optic tilt and haptic overstress during postoperative capsular bag fibrosis.

mechanisms.name: Sectoral fibrosis with directional shrinkage
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Localized contraction in a capsular sector drives asymmetric contact and tilt/decentration, a clinically observed failure mode leading to visual disturbances.

mechanisms.name: Anterior capsulorhexis phimosis
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Contraction of the anterior capsule rim increases anterior edge tension and can impinge on haptic crowns, altering load paths and inducing malposition.

deviation.detail: All credibility factors and overall model risk are rated on a 0–4 Credibility Index (0=None, 1=Low, 2=Moderate, 3=High, 4=Very High).

spans: Sensitivity to capsular modulus (0.5–1.2 MPa) shifts peak stress by 8.5% and tilt by 0.06° in Model D3; analogous shifts occur in Model RB.

Variation across the ranges reported above changes the computed peak haptic stress by less than 10% under uniform contraction and by 10–18% under sectoral and phimosis scenarios, while optic tilt and decentration shift by less than 0.1° and 0.05 mm under uniform contraction and up to 0.3° and 0.06 mm in asymmetric cases.

spans: We configured pre- and post-processing templates to min-imize variability across routine design studies.
These include standardized meshing scripts, contact parameter presets with bounds on normal stiffness and stabilization, and output check-lists that compute tilt and decentration consistently.

A companion guide recommends parameter sweeps for capsular modulus and contraction extent on new designs and flags conditions under which the reduced model should not be applied without confirmation by the detailed model.
Training materials describe typical failure modes such as inverted contact normals and misaligned axes and how to diagnose them.

spans: Model RB represents the capsular bag as a closed circular ring with distributed radial springs to emulate zonular coupling and overall stiffness.
Contact is represented by nonlinear springs coupling beam nodes to the ring with gap activation and a small tangential penalty to emulate friction.
findings.span: Model RB represents the capsular bag as a closed circular ring with distributed radial springs to emulate zonular coupling and overall stiffness.

spans: For uniform equatorial contracture, we apply an 8% azimuthal prestrain over a 3-mm-wide equatorial band (Model D3) or the full ring (Model RB).

The friction coefficient between the device and bag is set to 0.05; sensitivity analysis at 0.02 and 0.10 had negligible effect on predicted kinematics and less than 5% effect on peak contact pressure.
findings.span: For uniform equatorial contracture, we apply an 8% azimuthal prestrain over a 3-mm-wide equatorial band (Model D3) or the full ring (Model RB).

spans: Halving step sizes produced changes below 0.5% for stress and 0.01° for tilt.
Contact regularization in the nonlinear springs was tuned to keep artificial energy below 0.2% of the total across all runs.
findings.span: Halving step sizes produced changes below 0.5% for stress and 0.01° for tilt.

spans: Model RB can rapidly survey design parameter spaces to eliminate geometries with insufficient stiffness or excessive kinematic changes, while Model D3 can confirm margins in the highest-risk scenarios and provide local stress and contact details to direct geometric refinements such as crown fillet radii.
